name: Amsale
band_note: no priced staple; Bridal and occasionwear house: every product is a wedding gown, bridesmaid dress, evening dress, Little White Dress, bridal topper/cape or a
why: Bridal gowns (about $4,000–$12,000), bridesmaid dresses and evening and ready-to-wear dresses (about $500–$1,850), sold through its SoHo salon, its website and bridal salons.
origin: Founded in 1986 by Amsale Aberra; Neil Brown.

ownership.owner: The Amsale Group (site operated by Amsale Aberra, LLC; privately held)

quote.q: I believe that true style knows no place or time – more than an aesthetic, STYLE is a way of living

opview: “I believe that true style knows no place or time – more than an aesthetic, STYLE is a way of living” — Amsale Aberra, founder, The Designer page, amsale.com

facts_read.source: brand site; Harvard Business School alumni profile (Neil Brown); Vinted catalogue page; TRR designer directory; B Lab directory; GOTS database

price_read.sublines: Amsale and Nouvelle Amsale — bridal, bridesmaid, evening and Little White Dress lines (all occasionwear); nothing in scope

doors.note: Store locator lists bridal salons/retailers by city (Bergdorf Goodman, Bella Bridesmaids, The White Gown, etc. — wholesale). Only Amsale-named row is the flagship at 150 Wooster St, New York (nav labels it 'Amsale Flagship'). Appointment-based bridal.

fibre.sample: stratified sample of 80 across the house's three lines, proportional; 344 styles from 410 listings in /collections/all-ready-to-wear (79), /collections/all-brid

craft_evidence.owned: claim with place — 'each design is delicately handcrafted using couture dressmaking techniques in AMSALE's New York City atelier'; custom bridal patterned there
craft_evidence.madein: 46% (37 of 80, all 'Made in Thailand'; the other 43 pages state no country)
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed — began with the founder's own 1985 wedding dress; headquartered in New York City with a Soho salon; 'over three decades' of couture bridal
craft_evidence.process: partial — custom bridal page describes sketch, fabric selection, patterning at the NYC atelier and a 16-week fitting process
craft_evidence.reasoning: The house claims every design is handcrafted in its New York atelier and documents the custom-bridal process there. But every product page that states a country says Made in Thailand, evening and bridal alike, so the atelier claim does not hold for the range sold online. That conflict keeps it at 2.
